answer_1.quote: The generator utilizes the power of the pre-trained T5 model to rewrite incomplete utterances. ... We introduce a simple but effective model ... named JET (Joint learning token Extraction and Text generation).
answer_1.outputs: Restored/re-written utterances for incomplete dialogue turns

answer_2.quote: We followed prior work to use three different metrics for evaluation, including ROUGE-scores, BLUE-scores, and f-scores.

answer_4.quote: We asked three annotators who are well skilled in English and data annotation ... Each annotator read each output and gave a score (1: bad; 2: acceptable; 3: good). Following we adopted Text flow and Understandability as our criteria.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated each generated utterance on a 1-3 scale according to the criteria Text flow and Understandability.
